responsibility: Implements language-independent per-location warning suppression state. It maps option codes into coarse warning-group bitsets, stores those suppressions in a GC-allocated hash map keyed by location_t, and provides the operations to query, set, clear, and copy suppression state so front ends and middle-end code can honor statement- or expression-specific nowarn behavior.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for per-location warning suppression: it maps OPT_* values into nowarn groups and implements the mutable nowarn_map operations such as query, set, clear, and copy, whereas diagnostic-spec.h mainly defines the nowarn_spec_t bitset type and map declaration.
